_note: Veklom convenience document describing its MCP server. Not an MCP standard discovery URI.
name: Veklom
description: Separates an agent's ability to run from its authority to make an action real. Discovery tools are public; action tools need the caller's own credential, and CAPPO decides every consequential action.

auth.obtain: Sign up at https://veklom.com/signup. A signed-in person can mint a machine token for an agent. A successful mount returns a holder credential (vlm_...) limited to that mount.
